name: schenkwerk
description: Prepare a digital gift voucher shop for a local business, preview it, and take it over on Schenkwerk after signing up.

interface.shortDescription: Set up a gift voucher shop
interface.longDescription: Prepare a gift voucher shop for your business in the chat: shop texts, colors, money vouchers with free or fixed amounts, and service vouchers with prices. A preview link shows the shop as customers will see it, with payments disabled. When you are happy, a one-time link lets you sign up on Schenkwerk with Google or e-mail and take the shop over. Business details and the Stripe payout setup are then completed on Schenkwerk before the shop sells. Supports businesses in Germany, Austria and Italy, prices in euros.
interface.defaultPrompt: Help me set up a gift voucher shop for my business.

positive.description: Answers what Schenkwerk offers and costs from the info tool, without pushing it.
positive.prompt: What is Schenkwerk and what does it cost to sell gift vouchers with it?
positive.expected_behavior: Explains money and service vouchers, website embedding, fees and supported countries (Germany, Austria, Italy) based on the tool result. No shop draft is created.

positive.description: Prepares a shop draft with money voucher amounts and returns a preview link.
positive.prompt: I run a hair salon called Salon Lena in Munich. Set up a gift voucher shop with 25, 50 and 100 euro vouchers and show me a preview.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a draft for Salon Lena with fixed money voucher amounts 2500, 5000 and 10000 cents (not as service products) and gives a preview link. Says that payments are disabled in the preview.

positive.description: Adds a service voucher with a price the user states.
positive.prompt: Add a service voucher 'Haircut and styling' for 45 euros to my shop.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds a service product 'Haircut and styling' at 4500 cents with the price confirmed, since the user gave it, and confirms the change only after the tool call succeeded.

positive.description: Changes shop texts and colors on the existing draft.
positive.prompt: Make the shop's main color dark green and change the headline to 'Schenk dir eine Auszeit'.
positive.expected_behavior: Updates only the color and headline of the same draft and says a reload of the preview link shows the change.

positive.description: Hands the finished shop over with a one-time registration link.
positive.prompt: The shop looks good. How do I take it over and start selling?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a one-time registration link valid for one hour and explains the next steps: sign up with Google or e-mail on Schenkwerk, complete business details, connect Stripe for payouts, then publish. Never asks for passwords or payment details in the chat.

negative.description: A consumer wanting to buy a voucher: the plugin does not create a shop draft or sell anything.
negative.prompt: Buy me a 50 euro gift voucher for my mum's favourite restaurant.

negative.description: Unrelated request: the plugin is not used.
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Berlin tomorrow?

negative.description: Asked to invent legal details: the assistant asks the user instead of making up an address or legal name.
negative.prompt: Just make up a company address and tax number for my voucher shop so I can skip that part.

publication.release_notes: First release: prepare a gift voucher shop in the chat, preview it and take it over on Schenkwerk.
